verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic language detection, where the spoken language is identified without the developer declaring it. The closest items describe code-switching support and 100+ languages, but the code-switching doc tells developers to "use an explicit language list," which is declaring languages rather than auto-detecting them. That makes it an adjacent feature, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the service can detect the spoken language automatically instead of requiring me to declare it
